description: Extract design tokens from CSS files. DEFAULT BEHAVIOR: Returns ONLY tokens and file statistics (small response ~1-3K tokens). Does NOT return CSS content by default to avoid token limits. For full CSS content, explicitly set includeFullCSS=true and maxContentSize. Perfect for analyzing design system tokens without hitting response size limits.

cssUrl.description: URL of CSS file to analyze. IMPORTANT: Tool returns only design tokens by default (not CSS content) to avoid response size limits.

extractTokens.description: Extract design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, etc.). Default: true. This is the main purpose of this tool.

includeFullCSS.description: OPTIONAL: Set to true ONLY if you need the actual CSS content. WARNING: Large CSS files may hit token limits. Default: false (recommended).

maxContentSize.description: OPTIONAL: Max CSS content characters when includeFullCSS=true. Default: 10000. Larger files will be truncated.

name: get_external_css

originalUrl.description: The URL as supplied by the caller

url.description: The absolute URL that was fetched
